name: Creator Design System / Themes / Bookings
description: Product theme for Zoho Bookings. Defines the Bookings-specific primary brand colour family (Vibrant Violet #4A18A8), since Bookings' brand anchor differs from Creator's Primary blue. All other foundation tokens (spacing, grids, typography, elevation, radius, accessibility) are inherited unchanged from design-system/foundations/.

source.note: Base hex supplied directly as the Zoho Bookings primary brand colour; scale generated by tint-to-white (0-400) and shade-to-black (600-950) from that anchor, consistent with the CDS foundation ramp method used in foundations/colours.json.

appliesTo: CTA / accent surfaces scoped to Bookings
brand-tinted soft surfaces for Bookings pages

primary.label: Bookings Violet
primary.description: Primary brand colour family for Zoho Bookings. Replaces the shared foundation Primary (blue) when rendering Bookings surfaces.
primary.useFor: Bookings CTA / accent surfaces · brand anchors · hero moments

notes: 500 is the exact brand hex supplied (#4A18A8) — not adjusted for saturation.
0-400 are linear tints toward white; 600-950 are linear shades toward black, anchored on 500 — same construction method as foundations/colours.json ramps.
This file overrides only the primary family for Bookings context. Neutrals, secondary/tertiary accents, and all non-colour foundations remain shared from design-system/foundations/.
Verify contrast pairs (text on 0-100 tints, white text on 600-950 shades) against design-system/accessibility/wcag.json before shipping.
